REASON 01
Stay Active For The People Who Need You Most
Your heart works every second of every day. Supporting healthy circulation today can help you stay active, independent, and able to enjoy more years with your family.
That's why every serving combines 10,800 FU of nattokinase with 6 co-factors to support long-term cardiovascular health.

headings: H2: 7 Quality Ingredients, Chosen With Purpose
sections.text:
7 Quality Ingredients, Chosen With Purpose
NATTOKINASE
Nattokinase
500 mg · 10,800 FU
The enzyme at the center of the formula, isolated from traditional Japanese natto. It's studied for supporting the body's normal fibrinolytic activity—the natural process that keeps blood flowing smoothly.
BROMELAIN
Bromelain
6 mg · 2400 GDU/g
An enzyme from pineapple that supports the body's normal inflammatory response and complements nattokinase's circulatory support—part of keeping your system running comfortably day to day.
TURMERIC
Turmeric
50 mg
Its active compound, curcumin, is one of the most-studied botanicals and antioxidants for supporting a healthy inflammatory response, so your body has backup for the everyday wear it's managing.
COENZYME Q10
Coenzyme Q10
A compound your heart muscle uses for cellular energy—and one the body makes less of with age. It's here to support the energy production that keeps you feeling like yourself.
GINGER
Ginger
30 mg
A traditional root that supports healthy circulation and digestion, chosen to round out the formula's whole-system approach rather than target one number in isolation.
OLIVE LEAF
Olive Leaf
9 mg
Rich in oleuropein, a polyphenol studied for supporting healthy blood vessels and antioxidant defense—support for the vascular system you're trying to take care of.
WHITE WILLOW BARK
White Willow Bark
5 mg
The traditional source of salicin, included for its supportive role alongside the other botanicals in the formula's circulatory and comfort
